course.title: Fingerstyle Guitar: A Meditative Journey
course.philosophy: Therapeutic, meditative approach. Each session is a practice in presence — the guitar as a tool for stillness as much as sound.

modules.name: Arriving at the Instrument
modules.goal: Build a relaxed, sustainable hand position and introduce the thumb-finger independence that underpins all fingerstyle playing.

exercises.title: The Breathing Hand
exercises.description: Practice resting your plucking hand on the guitar and releasing tension finger by finger, learning to feel the strings before making a single sound.

exercises.title: Thumb Pulse
exercises.description: Play a steady, slow bass note with the thumb on a single open string, focusing entirely on consistent tone and the physical sensation of release.

exercises.title: One Finger at a Time
exercises.description: Assign index, middle, and ring fingers to strings 1, 2, and 3 and pluck each finger in isolation, noticing the difference in tone between a forced and a relaxed stroke.

modules.name: The Heartbeat Pattern
modules.goal: Establish a stable alternating-bass pattern and introduce the p-i-m-a sequence as a foundation for independent voice control.

exercises.title: Bass and Breath
exercises.description: Alternate the thumb between two bass strings on a single open chord, synchronizing each stroke with an exhale to internalize a meditative rhythm.

exercises.title: Travis Seed
exercises.description: Combine the alternating thumb with a single repeated treble finger to experience the basic Travis-picking skeleton before adding complexity.

exercises.title: p-i-m-a Loop
exercises.description: Arpeggiate four strings in sequence (p-i-m-a) on one chord, looping continuously until the pattern becomes automatic and the mind can settle.

modules.name: Chords That Flow
modules.goal: Develop fluid chord transitions without breaking the fingerpicking pattern, turning chord changes into a seamless part of the musical texture.

exercises.title: The Anchor Finger
exercises.description: Practice transitioning between two chords by keeping one shared finger planted on the fretboard, using that stillness as a physical anchor.

exercises.title: Change on the Exhale
exercises.description: Play a four-bar loop and make every chord change on a designated beat tied to an exhale, training the body to release rather than tense at transition points.

exercises.title: Pattern Over Three Chords
exercises.description: Apply the p-i-m-a arpeggio to a I–IV–V progression, letting the pattern run uninterrupted across chord changes to build unconscious muscle memory.

modules.name: Singing Melodies
modules.goal: Layer a melody on top of an accompaniment pattern, teaching students to hear and balance two independent voices in a single instrument.

exercises.title: Melody Alone First
exercises.description: Play a simple 8-note melody on the high strings with only the fingers (no thumb), focusing on voicing each note with intention and equal weight.

exercises.title: Bass Holds the Ground
exercises.description: Add a slow, steady thumb bass beneath the melody and practice letting the bass disappear from conscious awareness while the melody stays in the foreground.

exercises.title: Pinch and Sustain
exercises.description: Practice pinching the thumb and one finger simultaneously to strike a bass note and melody note together, sustaining the high note across subsequent thumb strokes.

modules.name: Dynamics and Space
modules.goal: Explore volume, tone colour, and silence as expressive tools, moving beyond mechanical correctness into felt musical communication.

exercises.title: The Fade
exercises.description: Play a repeating pattern and gradually reduce volume over eight bars to near-silence, then grow back, learning to control dynamics with finger weight rather than tension.

exercises.title: Ponticello to Dolce
exercises.description: Shift your plucking hand from near the bridge (bright, present) to near the soundhole (warm, recessed) mid-phrase to experience the guitar's full tonal range.

exercises.title: The Rest Stroke Accent
exercises.description: Insert a single rest-stroke note at the emotional peak of a phrase to make one note ring above the texture, practising the art of emphasis through restraint.

modules.name: A Complete Voice
modules.goal: Integrate all previous skills into a full piece, developing personal interpretation and establishing a sustainable daily practice ritual.

exercises.title: The Sketch Piece
exercises.description: Compose a 16-bar original piece using only three chords and one of the patterns learned earlier, prioritising feel and intention over technical complexity.

exercises.title: Slow Mirror Practice
exercises.description: Play a known piece at half-speed while watching the plucking hand in a mirror, using the visual feedback to identify and dissolve any remaining physical tension.

exercises.title: The Daily Ritual
exercises.description: Design a personal 10-minute opening ritual — tuning, a single long tone, one technical exercise, one expressive passage — to be used at the start of every practice session.
